record.field: Every computed payslip deducts one instalment. A closing balance under two instalments is taken in full so the loan can finish.
# One instalment per payslip; a closing balance under two # instalments is taken in full so the loan can finish. result = min(per, balance) if 0.005 < balance - result < per: result = balance
Deducts one instalment only on the payslip whose period covers the last day of a month; other slips take nothing.
Deducts one instalment only on the payslip whose period covers the 15th; other slips take nothing.
Example of a client-specific rule: takes two instalments per payslip so the loan repays twice as fast. Duplicate and edit for each client tier.
